summary: Log repeatedly prints the message "Ticking entity", and finally crashes the game
description: The bug I m just moving around in my jungle world while trying to record a youtube video. Windows that were open are chrome, obs, sticky notes, streamlabs obs, and the minecraft launcher, as well as the game The game will crash after moving around a little bit. Very lagging in the jungle, the log repeatedly prints the message "Ticking entity", and finally crashes the game. Reproduce - Create a superflat world of jungle biome, and fly freely on the world. minecraft:bedrock,63 minecraft:dirt,minecraft:grass_block;minecraft:jungle;biome_1,decoration,lake,lava_lake - Using spawn eggs to spawn very many parrots. - Use the following command /tp @e[type=parrot] @p Here is the crash report: 19w40a: [^crash-2019-10-03_23.59.03-client.txt] Description: Ticking entity java.lang.NullPointerException: Ticking entity at atd.a(SourceFile:407) at akm.ab(SourceFile:301) at akn.ab(SourceFile:228) at akd.h(SourceFile:399) at akm.h(SourceFile:2059) at akn.h(SourceFile:295) at atk.h(SourceFile:34) at dmr.a(SourceFile:165) at bjk.a(SourceFile:648) at dmr.g(SourceFile:136) at das.n(SourceFile:1389) at das.d(SourceFile:907) at das.b(SourceFile:569) at net.minecraft.client.main.Main.main(SourceFile:199)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Create a new Superflat world with the following settings: `minecraft:bedrock,63 minecraft:dirt,minecraft:grass_block;minecraft:jungle;biome_1,decoration,lake,lava_lake`.
3. Use spawn eggs to spawn many parrots in the world.
4. Execute the command `/tp @e[type=parrot] @p` to teleport all parrots to your position.
5. Move around freely in the jungle biome while monitoring for lag and repeated log messages "Ticking entity".
6. Observe that the game crashes after moving around a little bit, with the log repeatedly printing "Ticking entity" before the crash.

7. Take a screenshot or record video of the crash behavior if possible.
8. Exit the game and gather the `debug` folder and `latest.log` file for further analysis.
Observed Behavior: The game crashes while moving around in a jungle world, particularly when recording a YouTube video with multiple applications open such as Chrome, OBS, Sticky Notes, Streamlabs OBS, and the Minecraft launcher. The log repeatedly prints "Ticking entity" before the crash occurs. This issue is more noticeable due to significant lag within the jungle biome. To reproduce this bug, create a superflat world with a jungle biome using the following command: `minecraft:bedrock,63 minecraft:dirt,minecraft:grass_block;minecraft:jungle;biome_1,decoration,lake,lava_lake`. Use spawn eggs to populate the area with many parrots and execute the command `/tp @e[type=parrot] @p` to teleport all parrots to the player. The crash report indicates a `NullPointerException` during entity ticking: "Description: Ticking entity java.lang.NullPointerException: Ticking entity at atd.a(SourceFile:407) at akm.ab(SourceFile:301)". This information should help developers understand and address the issue more effectively.
Expected Behavior: When following the reproduction steps in a jungle biome with many parrots spawned using spawn eggs and teleported near the player, the game should remain stable and not crash. The log should not repeatedly print "Ticking entity," and the gameplay should be smooth without excessive lag or interruptions.
